description: Turns the comprehension debt left by vibe coding into active learning: generates questions about your own code, grades your answers, and tracks what you actually understand. UI and generated questions are Japanese only for now.
command.startSession.title: CodeLitmus: Start comprehension check (current file)
command.showRecentFiles.title: CodeLitmus: Open a recently checked file
configuration.pythonPath.description: Absolute path to the Python executable used to launch the CodeLitmus backend (main.py) — e.g. the python.exe of a conda env. The backend cannot start while this is unset.
